system.notes:
Prospero was once the Overlord’s favored jester. He was a supreme acrobat and showman, able to perform dazzling leaps and juggling feats that no other harlequin dared. Rumors held that Prospero had fey magic in his blood. One day, a noble guest in the Overlord’s court suddenly threw off her disguise, revealing a trained wizard-assassin from Khadesh. She flung a mind-shattering spell at the Overlord, but a darting flash of checkered cloth and tinkling bells intercepted the bolt. Then, chaos erupted in the throne room. Later, some courtesans would say they saw Prospero stagger to a hidden panel in the wall and disappear down a flight of stairs that led to the citadel’s dank dungeons...

AC 14, HP 40, ATK 3 juggling knives (close/near) +6 (1d6) and 1 got your nose and 1 dazzling orb, MV near (climb), S +1, D +4, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 9

Dazzling Orb. All creatures in near DC 15 CON or blinded for 1 round by a brilliant flash of multicolored light.

Got Your Nose. The Jester makes a DC 15 DEX check to magically pluck an ear, nose, or eye from a creature within close. Stolen anatomy is stored in a bag the Jester carries (can be re-attached by placing in original location).

Induce Fugue. Each time a creature misses an attack or fails a spellcasting check targeting The Mad Jester, that creature loses 1 XP (0 minimum).

Tumble. In place of attacks, move up to double near. The Mad Jester’s AC becomes 18 until the start of his next turn.

Art by Jessee Egan
